consensus_method.line_rule: consensus line = line quoted two-sided by the most distinct books; ties -> closest to the median of all two-sided lines for that player-game; ties -> lower line. Books not quoting the consensus line are EXCLUDED AND COUNTED, never blended across thresholds (D036 point 5: thresholds are never conflated)
consensus_method.epistemic_status_line: MARKET-REACTION SYSTEM COMPONENT under the four-system separation. Estimates a consensus fair line from multi-book quotes. It models the market, not the game; its output is never a fundamental prediction and is labelled per the M00 ladder.
